text: On 16 August 2012, South African police opened fire and killed 34 striking miners at Marikana who were protesting against low wages.
short: South African police killed 34 striking miners at Marikana in 2012.

source.name: Human Rights Watch: South Africa: NPA still wrong in Lonmin matter
source.quote: The tragic scenes of August 16, 2012, when police opened fire and killed 34 miners who were part of a group protesting against low wages, sent shockwaves throughout the world.
source.note: Commentary by Cameron Jacobs, Human Rights Watch's South Africa director.

additionalSources.name: Amnesty International: South Africa: Five years on, Marikana victims still wait for justice
additionalSources.quote: Victims of the bloody tragedy at Marikana, in which 34 protesters were killed and at least 70 were injured by members of the South African Police Service (SAPS) during a mining strike
additionalSources.note: Amnesty also reports that the Farlam Commission, set up by the South African government, recommended investigating the criminal liability of SAPS members involved.
